title: Block that looks like a crafting table but kills you
description: Adds a block that looks like a crafting table but kills you when you right click on it
body:
**Adds a minecraft block that looks like a crafting table but kills you when you right click on it. That's it. I spent maybe 10 minutes on this mod. Why did I make this.**

I made this with Mcreator cause I cant be bothered to learn Java
